象蜡的,苍白的, 柔软的,
words.ex_en: the waxy blossoms of the water lily
words.ex_zh: 睡莲那如蜡一般的花朵

words.zh: 无人居住的,杳无人迹的

words.ex_en: They liked their churches to be unadorned.
words.ex_zh: 他们希望他们的教堂朴素无华。

words.ex_en: She led a chaste decent life.
words.ex_zh: 她过着贞洁正派的生活。

words.ex_en: They followed the sinuous trail deep into the mountains.
words.ex_zh: 他们沿着弯弯曲曲的小径进入深山。

words.zh: 措辞, 用语, 言语

words.ex_en: This solution is politically expedient but may well cause long-term problems.
words.ex_zh: 这种解决方法是政治上的权宜之计，但会引起长远的问题。

words.ex_en: In Maine, the most commonly counted roadkill species is the North American porcupine.
words.ex_zh: 在缅因州，公路交通事故中杀死的动物种类是北美箭猪。

words.zh: 精神错乱， 神志失常
words.ex_en: Before she died she had fits of delirium.
words.ex_zh: 去世前她一阵阵地胡言乱语。

words.ex_en: More exercises can avoid atrophy of cartilage.
words.ex_zh: 多加锻炼可以避免软骨萎缩。

words.zh: 不合作的, 不配合的
words.ex_en: She became uncooperative: unwilling to do her homework or help with any household chores.
words.ex_zh: 她变得不合作起来：不愿做作业或是帮助分担家务。

words.ex_en: Her handwriting was so tiny it was barely legible.
words.ex_zh: 她的字写得这么小，简直都看不清楚。

words.zh: 不调和的, 不适宜的
words.ex_en: The incongruity of her situation struck Gina with unpleasant force.
words.ex_zh: 吉娜猛然意识到自己处境尴尬，心里很不舒服。

words.zh: 有毒的， 分泌毒液的； 恶意的， 狠毒的
words.ex_en: Lisa shot him a venomous glance.
words.ex_zh: 莉萨恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼。
